Overview & City Profile

Steinen (Steinen (BFS 1373)) is a municipality in Bezirk Schwyz, Schwyz (coordinates 47.0517°N, 8.6095°E; population 3,608). Visitors use Steinen as a base to explore Schwyz's historic town centers, regional markets, and culinary specialties such as Cheese fondue, Raclette, Rösti.

Within Schwyz Region (Bezirk Schwyz region), Steinen (Steinen (BFS 1373)) serves as a municipality (gemeinde / commune) in schwyz region. Travelers exploring Schwyz often combine a stop in Steinen with regional highlights such as Historic Altstadt / Old Town, Panoramic mountain & lake views, Marked SwitzerlandMobility hiking trails, Local heritage museum.

Getting to Steinen & Getting Around

Via the regional hub (Freienbach Central Station (SBB CFF FFS & Panoramic Alpine Railways)): Connected via hourly SBB CFF FFS rail and PostBus services; fully covered by the Swiss Travel Pass.

  • Local rail & IC cards: Once in Schwyz Region, JR regional lines and local private railways connect Freienbach with Steinen. Nationwide IC cards (Transit Card, Pasmo, Icoca) work on major urban and JR commuter gates; for rural branch lines or local buses, keep CHF 1,000 bills and CHF 100 coins handy for the onboard fare box.
  • Luggage & station lockers: Main stations in Schwyz have coin lockers for day-trippers. If you are stopping in Steinen en route between larger bases, check your suitcase dimensions in our Luggage & Locker Checker or forward big bags ahead with Takkyubin.
  • Driving & car rental: While city centers around Steinen are accessible by train and taxi, renting a car from a major SBB CFF FFS & Panoramic Alpine Railways station or airport in Schwyz can be rewarding for reaching mountain gorges, coastal viewpoints, and countryside onsen. Read our Renting a Car in Switzerland Guide.

Practical Travel Tips for Steinen

  • Tourist information center (観光案内所): Look for the Kankō Annaijo counter inside or right outside the main train station in Steinen (or at Freienbach Central Station (SBB CFF FFS & Panoramic Alpine Railways)) for free walking maps, bus timetables, and festival calendars.
  • Cash & ATMs: While hotels, chain stores, and convenience stores in Steinen accept international cards and IC payment, smaller family-run restaurants, shrines, and rural buses often prefer cash. 7-Eleven (Seven Bank) and Switzerland Post ATMs accept foreign debit cards reliably.
  • Dining hours: Outside major metropolitan hubs, lunch typically runs 11:30 AM–2:00 PM and dinner spots open around 5:30 PM, with earlier last orders (around 8:00–9:00 PM) in smaller cities.

Frequently asked questions

Where is Steinen (Steinen (BFS 1373)) located in Switzerland?

Steinen (Steinen (BFS 1373)) is a municipality (gemeinde / commune) located in Schwyz Region in the Bezirk Schwyz region of Switzerland (coordinates: 47.0517°N, 8.6095°E). It has a population of approximately 3,608 across an area of Regional km².

How do I get to Steinen by train?

Most visitors reach Steinen via the main prefectural gateway of Freienbach Central Station (SBB CFF FFS & Panoramic Alpine Railways). Connected via hourly SBB CFF FFS rail and PostBus services; fully covered by the Swiss Travel Pass. From the regional hub, connect by JR local/rapid lines, private commuter railways, or local bus to Steinen. You can estimate long-distance rail costs using our SBB CFF FFS & Panoramic Alpine Railways Fare Calculator.

What local food is Steinen and Schwyz known for?

In Steinen and across Schwyz Region, top local dishes include Cheese fondue, Raclette, Rösti, as well as Bircher muesli and Swiss artisanal chocolate. Look for local ekiben (station bento boxes), morning markets, and family-run shokudo near the main station.

When is the best time of year to visit Steinen?

Best time to visit Schwyz: Jun–Sep (summer trails), Dec–Mar (winter sports). Check our Switzerland Seasonal Calendar to compare month-by-month weather and crowd levels.
